unmapped_blocks.text: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer — Frontend & Full Stack | Amzur Infotech Pvt Ltd | Visakhapatnam, India • March 2019 –
Present
Angular & React Application Development
▸ Developed and delivered 5+ enterprise SPAs using Angular (v8–v18) and React, serving thousands of concurrent users
with sub-2-second load times through advanced lazy loading, code splitting, and tree-shaking strategies.
▸ Engineered a modular, reusable component library leveraging Angular Standalone Components, reducing new feature
development time by an estimated 30% across projects.
▸ Designed and implemented role-based access control (RBAC) systems and permissions-driven UI for enterprise-grade
applications, ensuring compliance with security and business logic requirements.
▸ Optimized Angular change detection strategies (OnPush, Zone.js tuning) and implemented virtual scrolling, reducing
rendering bottlenecks by up to 40% in data-heavy dashboards.
▸ Delivered fully responsive, cross-browser-compatible interfaces across Angular Material, PrimeNG, Syncfusion, Kendo
UI, and Tailwind CSS — meeting WCAG accessibility standards.
API Integration & Full Stack Contributions
▸ Collaborated with backend engineers to design RESTful API contracts and contributed to end-to-end full-stack feature
delivery using Node.js and Express.js.
Integrated real-time data pipelines and dynamic dashboard experiences by consuming complex REST APIs, enabling live
data visualization for business stakeholders.
Implemented Stripe payment gateway and Google API integrations, enabling commerce and geolocation capabilities in
production applications.
AI Engineering & Intelligent Feature Development
▸ Built and deployed production-ready AI-powered chatbot interfaces integrated with OpenAI APIs, including dynamic
response handling, context-aware conversation flows, and intelligent UI design patterns.
▸ Developed LLM-powered features using LangChain, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and MCP (Model
Context Protocol), enabling knowledge-grounded AI responses within web applications.
Implemented N8N automation workflows to orchestrate multi-step AI agent pipelines, reducing manual data processing
effort across internal operations.
▸ Applied advanced prompt engineering techniques and leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate feature development,
improve code quality, and reduce boilerplate code generation time by ~25%.
Engineering Excellence & Team Collaboration
▸ Maintained >85% unit test coverage across modules using Jest, Karma, and Jasmine — enforcing quality gates in CI/CD
pipelines via Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
▸ Actively participated in Agile/SCRUM ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and daily
stand-ups — consistently delivering features on or ahead of schedule.
▸ Mentored junior developers in Angular best practices, component architecture, and RxJS patterns, fostering a culture of
clean, maintainable code.
▸ Managed source control, branching strategies, and release workflows using Git and Jenkins, supporting continuous
deployment across multiple environments.
Junior IT Consultant | Primor Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd | Visakhapatnam • July 2018 – March 2019
▸ Delivered frontend development support on Angular-based client projects, gaining foundational expertise in
component-driven architecture, API integration, and Agile workflows.
Junior IT Consultant | Thrill Health and Wellness Pvt Ltd | Visakhapatnam • November 2017 – July 2018
▸ Contributed to Angular web development in the health-tech domain, assisting in building responsive interfaces and
consuming healthcare APIs in a fast-paced startup environment.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) | Raghu Institute of Technology, Visakhapatnam 2012 – 2015 • CGPA: 7.10
Diploma in Engineering | Govt Polytechnic College, Parvathipuram 2009 – 2012 • Score: 80.40%
SSC (10th Grade) | SVD Gangadhar High School, Vizianagaram 2008 – 2009 • GPA: 89.89%
TECHNICAL ACHIEVEMENTS & HIGHLIGHTS
Enterprise Architecture: Successfully delivered full-lifecycle enterprise solutions over an 8-year tenure, consistently
bridging complex business requirements with scalable, maintainable architectures in Angular, React, and AWS
ecosystems.
▸ AI Platform Engineering: Architected and deployed a production-grade AI platform (FastAPI, LangChain,
ChromaDB) featuring a custom RAG pipeline and multi-model routing via LiteLLM; delivered an enterprise-ready
solution with async ORM architecture and 100% automated test validation.
Technical Leadership: Served as Angular Tech Lead for Wellgistics Health, guiding a 6-engineer team in defining
component standards and architectural patterns; maintained zero critical production incidents for a high-volume
healthcare logistics platform.
Engineering Efficiency: Accelerated development velocity by 25% by pioneering the strategic adoption of
AI-assisted workflows, including GitHub Copilot integration, N8N automation pipelines, and multi-provider LLM
proxy patterns.
▸ Cross-Domain Problem Solving: Demonstrated advanced technical depth by integrating a complex algorithmic
game engine (Minimax with alpha-beta pruning) into a React frontend, showcasing proficiency in both front-end UI
architecture and backend algorithmic complexity.
▸ High-Scale Reliability: Established rigorous quality gates and CI/CD protocols that sustained >85% unit test
coverage across multiple enterprise SPAs, ensuring seamless reliability for thousands of concurrent users.
